annotations.annotation_text: (French) Go to hell! Goddamn![1] Zut is a coarse exclamation signifying refusal or (as here) dismissal.[2] Nom de Dieu (literally, name of God) is a blasphemous oath signifying shock or indignation.
sources: Gifford, Don, and Robert J. Seidman. Ulysses Annotated. University of California Press, 1988.
